raidItems.title: Vendor IBM MQ Mainframe Gateway Delivery Delay
raidItems.description: Third-party core vendor may miss May 15 SLA for production grade MQ gateway test sandbox.
raidItems.mitigationStrategy: Stand up synthetic mock stub endpoints to unblock local consumer development; escalate penalty clause with vendor account VP.
raidItems.contingencyPlan: Contract secondary certified integration partner (Accenture) for custom adapter bridge.

raidItems.title: Cloud Egress Cost Overrun on High-Frequency Event Replay
raidItems.description: Historical ledger reconciliation across US-East and EU-West regions could inflate network egress fees beyond budget baseline.
raidItems.mitigationStrategy: Deploy localized caching and binary Protobuf compression; enforce peer-to-peer inter-zone compression.
raidItems.contingencyPlan: Throttle non-urgent historical sync jobs to off-peak night hours.

raidItems.title: Sanctions Screening API Rate Limiting in Staging
raidItems.description: Third-party LexisNexis sandbox is dropping 12% of peak test queries due to restrictive 25 RPS throttling limit.
raidItems.rootCause: Staging environment was provisioned on tier-2 developer plan rather than enterprise burstable tier.
raidItems.resolutionPlan: Procurement approved license upgrade; awaiting key provisioning by April 18.

raidItems.title: Central Bank ISO 20022 Schema Stability
raidItems.description: Assuming ISO 20022 pacs.008 schema definitions will remain locked through Q4 2026 release cycle.
raidItems.impactIfFalse: Breaking schema changes would require 3 weeks of regression testing and parser refactoring.

raidItems.title: Enterprise SSO Okta OIDC Upgrade
raidItems.description: Mobile and web bank portal single sign-on relies on IT Infrastructure completing Okta Identity Engine cutover.

raidItems.title: Offline SQLite Database Cipher Encryption Performance on Low-End Devices
raidItems.description: SQLCipher key derivation on budget handsets introduces potential latency during app cold boot.
raidItems.mitigationStrategy: Profile SQLite PRAGMA cipher_page_size and asynchronous memory pre-caching.
raidItems.contingencyPlan: Fallback to hardware-backed Keystore direct blob encryption.
